product_metadata.title: Anchor Hocking Montana Glass Jars with Fresh Sealed Lids, Brushed Metal, 96 oz (Set of 2)
features: INCLUDES: This Anchor Hocking glass jar set contains (2) 96-ounce jars and (2) brushed metal lids. Keep what you buy fresher, longer. Made of all-clear glass.
DURABLE: These glass jars with matching lids are wide mouthed and thick walled. Counter-top storage designed to ease scooping, prevent spills, and protect what you buy.Towel dry

USE: These glass jars are perfect to display all manner of dry goods including flour, rice, coffee, sugar, spices, and candy. But that’s not all. Make ideal cookie jars and cat and dog-treat containers.
GIFT: Not sure what to get that friend or family member moving into their new home? These glass jars make the perfect wedding gifts, holiday gifts, and birthday gifts.

SAFE: Anchor Hocking jars are healthier than plastic and metal. Cannisters are dishwasher safe and specifically designed so they will not warp, stain, retain smells, or leach dangerous chemicals into foods. Lids are hand wash only.

MADE IN USA: We began in Ohio in 1905 with the aim of maximizing your home’s potential. Today, as the leading pantry manufacturer, our goal and location are the same. That’s right. 115 years later, our glass jars are still proudly made in America.
description: A perfect place to store cereals, pastas, flour, sugar, or any of your favorite items! this jar is perfect for registries, new homeowners and holidays. Anchor glass is made in the USA.
